description.en: Curated animated React components crafted with Framer Motion and Tailwind.
description.zh: 基于 Framer Motion 与 Tailwind 打造的现代 React 动效与微交互组件库。

content.en: Cult UI is a collection of expressive, motion-rich React components built by the Nimpl team. Featuring glassmorphic surfaces, tactile drag interactions, dynamic island replicas, and fluid tab switches, it helps developers deliver distinctive, high-craft web experiences.
content.zh: Cult UI 是由 Nimpl 团队打造的先锋动效 React 组件库。全库深度结合 Framer Motion 与 Tailwind CSS，收录了诸如灵动岛卡片、物理拖拽交互控件、毛玻璃悬浮条与流体式 Tab 切换器等极具个性的界面实验与成品组件。
